qualification_history: The first replay stopped before launch because the prepared install-tree tar digest was incorrectly compared to the normalized snapshot-manifest digest. The final flow keeps the two exact identities distinct.
The second replay stopped during pack assembly because empty contradiction/limitation lists encoded as null. The producer now emits the schema-required empty arrays.

The third replay stopped after independent posture qualification because it incorrectly required two fresh run-specific posture objects to have equal CIDs. The final flow requires each posture to be independently qualified and binds the proposal to the verified baseline posture without equating volatile run evidence.
limits: This verifies one exact current Mastra 1.8.0, OpenBox Mastra SDK 1.0.0/base SDK 1.0.1, native Codex 0.149.0, local Ollama 0.31.1 granite4.1:3b, and local OpenBox source tuple on Darwin arm64.
Docker Compose ran only the disposable local OpenBox system plane. The evaluated project process was never launched by Docker.
The retained proposal is inert guidance and the candidate ran only in the erased isolated test decision environment; nothing was deployed or published.
The baseline and governed posture CIDs differ because each retains fresh run-specific probe/configuration evidence. Each posture is independently qualified; CID equality is not claimed.
The pack pair is a single observed baseline/governed execution pair. Release repetition and multi-host support remain SE-07-06 through SE-07-09 work.
